html: The pensions of the Judges of the High Court are regulated by the High Court Judges (Conditions of Service) Act, 1954, while those of All India Services by The All India Services (Death-cum-Retirement Benefits) Rules, 1958. The pension rules for I.C.S. are given in Chapter XLIX of the Civil Service Regulations. The pensions of Indian Police Officers are regulated by the Superior Civil Services (Pension) Rules/The All India Services (Death-cum-Retirement Benefits) Rules, 1958.
